sources.note: No phonology content: neither edition's entry has a 'Typology' line (no tone or stress information). Content is population '21,500 (2013 SIL)', location, status 6a, classification (Cross River, Bendi), dialects 'Ukpe, Bayobiri (Bayobre, Bayobri). Dialect cluster (Crozier and Blench 1992). Lexical similarity: 60%-64% with Ubang [uba], 60%-65% with Alege [alf], 35% with Bete-Bendi [btt]', language use ('Used by all. Most also use Elege [alf]. Some also use Bete-Bendi [btt], Ubang [uba]').
